name: rosetta-globally-replace-text-in-several-files
code:
use IO.Std.write_line
use IO.File

replace_in_file(source: string, destination: string) is
    let replaced =
        File.read_all_text(source)
            .replace("Goodbye London!", "Hello New York!")

    File.write_all_text(destination, replaced)

    write_line("{destination}:")
    write_line(File.read_all_text(destination))
si

replace_in_file("one.txt", "one.out.txt")
replace_in_file("two.txt", "two.out.txt")

use IO.Std.write_line
use IO.File

replace_in_file(source: string, destination: string) is
    let replaced =
        File.read_all_text(source)
            .replace("Goodbye London!", "Hello New York!")

    File.write_all_text(destination, replaced)

    write_line("{destination}:")
    write_line(File.read_all_text(destination))
si

replace_in_file("one.txt", "one.out.txt")
replace_in_file("two.txt", "two.out.txt")
